proxies.name: Military Budget (USD millions)
proxies.description: Annual military expenditure in current USD (millions) from the SIPRI Military Expenditure Database, covering personnel, operations, procurement and R&D. Higher = a larger absolute military budget (hard-power spending capacity).

proxies.name: % of UN Members Accepting ICJ Jurisdiction (%)
proxies.description: Percentage of UN member states (out of 193) with an active declaration accepting compulsory ICJ jurisdiction under Article 36(2), sourced from official ICJ declarations. A rising % signals strengthening global legal authority; a declining % signals erosion of the rules-based legal order.

proxies.name: Population Growth Rate (%)
proxies.description: Annual percentage change in total population, from the UN World Population Prospects. Higher = faster population growth; negative values indicate population decline.

proxies.name: Total Fertility Rate (births per woman)
proxies.description: Average number of children a woman would have over her lifetime at current age-specific fertility rates, from UN WPP. Higher = faster population renewal; below approximately 2.1 signals long-run population decline absent migration.

proxies.name: Life Expectancy at Birth (years)
proxies.description: Average number of years a newborn is expected to live under current mortality patterns, from UN WPP. Higher = greater longevity.

proxies.name: Median Age (years)
proxies.description: Age that divides the population into two equal halves, from UN WPP. Higher = an older population structure.

proxies.name: Population Aged 65+ Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population aged 65 and over, from UN WPP. Higher = a larger older-age cohort and greater ageing-related fiscal/care burden.

proxies.name: Youth Aged 15–24 Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population aged 15 to 24, from UN WPP. Higher = a larger youth cohort, implying both greater labour-market entry pressure and demographic dividend potential.

proxies.name: Old-Age Dependency Ratio (per 100 working-age)
proxies.unit: No, of people per 100 working-age people
proxies.description: Population aged 65+ per 100 people of working age (15–64), from UN WPP. Higher = a heavier support burden on the working-age population.

proxies.name: Working-Age Population Growth (%)
proxies.description: Annual percentage change in the working-age population, derived from UN WPP age-structure data. Higher = a faster-growing labour supply; negative values indicate a shrinking workforce.

proxies.name: Urban Population Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population living in cities or towns, from the UN World Urbanization Prospects. Higher = further along the urban transition.

proxies.name: Population in Largest City Share (%)
proxies.description: Population of a country's largest city as a percentage of its total urban population, from World Bank WDI. Higher = greater urban primacy and concentration in a single dominant city.

proxies.name: Ratification: Paris Agreement (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the Paris Agreement by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: UNTOC (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the UNTOC by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: UNCAC (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the UNCAC by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: Geneva Protocol I (1977) (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the Geneva Protocol I (1977) by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: Convention on Biological Diversity (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the Convention on Biological Diversity by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: UNCLOS (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the UNCLOS by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: Rome Statute (ICC) (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the Rome Statute (ICC) by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: ICCPR (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the ICCPR by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: NPT (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the NPT by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: Chemical Weapons Convention (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the Chemical Weapons Convention by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: CTBT (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the CTBT by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Ratification: Arms Trade Treaty (%)
proxies.description: Cumulative percentage of 193 UN member states that are party to the Arms Trade Treaty by calendar year-end. Pre-adoption zero years are dropped.

proxies.name: Urban Population Living in Slums (%)
proxies.description: Share of the urban population living in slum conditions, from UN-Habitat (via World Bank WDI). Higher = greater urban exclusion and housing deprivation.

proxies.name: International Migrant Stock Share (%)
proxies.description: International migrants as a share of the total population, from the UN DESA International Migrant Stock dataset (five-year intervals, interpolated). Higher = greater cross-border mobility and foreign-born presence.

proxies.name: Net Migration Rate (per 1,000 population)
proxies.description: Net number of migrants (immigrants minus emigrants) per 1,000 population, from UN WPP. Positive = net inflow; negative = net outflow.

proxies.name: Refugees Hosted (per 100,000 population)
proxies.description: Number of refugees hosted per 100,000 population, from UNHCR refugee statistics. Higher = greater refugee-hosting burden/responsibility.

proxies.name: Conflict-Related Internal Displacement (per 100,000)
proxies.description: New internal displacements caused by conflict and violence per 100,000 population, from the IDMC Global Internal Displacement Database. Higher = greater forced-mobility pressure from conflict.

proxies.name: Remittance Inflows (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Personal remittances received from abroad as a percentage of GDP, from World Bank / KNOMAD. Higher = greater reliance on diaspora income flows.

proxies.name: Healthy Life Expectancy (years)
proxies.description: Average number of years a person can expect to live in full health, from WHO's Global Health Observatory. Higher = longer healthy lifespan, not just longer lifespan.

proxies.name: Maternal Mortality Ratio (per 100,000 live births)
proxies.unit: No. of women per 100,000 live births
proxies.description: Maternal deaths per 100,000 live births, from the WHO / UN Maternal Mortality Estimation Inter-agency Group. Higher = worse maternal survival outcomes.

proxies.name: Under-Five Mortality Rate (per 1,000 live births)
proxies.unit: No. of people per 1,000 live births
proxies.description: Probability of dying before age five, per 1,000 live births, from the UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation. Higher = worse child survival outcomes.

proxies.name: UHC Service Coverage Index (0–100)
proxies.description: Composite index of coverage for essential health services, from WHO / World Bank. Higher = broader reach of essential healthcare.

proxies.name: Number of UN Peacekeepers (personnel)
proxies.description: Total uniformed personnel (troops, police, military observers) deployed by each country across all active UN peacekeeping missions as of December 31 each year, sourced from the UN Peace & Security Data Hub. Also includes a GLO series summing contributions across all 35 countries. Higher values indicate greater commitment to collective global security. Declining GLO trend signals systemic withdrawal from UN-led security cooperation.

proxies.name: Current Health Expenditure per Capita (USD)
proxies.description: Total current health spending per person, in current USD, from WHO / World Bank WDI. Higher = greater resources committed to the health system.

proxies.name: Upper-Secondary Completion Rate (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population of the relevant age group that has completed upper-secondary education, from UNESCO Institute for Statistics. Higher = stronger education attainment.

proxies.name: Youth NEET Rate (%, age 15–24)
proxies.description: Share of youth aged 15–24 not in employment, education or training, from ILOSTAT. Higher = greater school-to-work disconnect.

proxies.name: Nurses and Midwives per 1,000 People
proxies.unit: No. of nurses and midwives per 1,000 people
proxies.description: Density of nursing and midwifery personnel per 1,000 population, from WHO / World Bank WDI. Higher = greater frontline health-workforce capacity.

proxies.name: Mental-Health Burden: Depression & Anxiety Prevalence (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population with depressive or anxiety disorders, from the IHME Global Burden of Disease study. Higher = greater mental-health burden.

proxies.name: Poverty Headcount at $4.20/day, 2021 PPP (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population living below the $4.20/day (2021 PPP) poverty line, from the World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform. Higher = greater material deprivation.

proxies.name: Gini Index (0–100)
proxies.description: Standard measure of income inequality within a country, from the World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform. Higher = greater income inequality.

proxies.name: Vulnerable Employment Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of total employment in own-account work or unpaid family work, from ILOSTAT. Higher = greater employment insecurity.

proxies.name: Youth Unemployment Rate (%)
proxies.description: Share of the youth labour force (age 15–24) that is unemployed, from ILOSTAT. Higher = greater blocked economic opportunity for young people.

proxies.name: Gender Labour-Force Participation Gap (p.p.)
proxies.description: Male labour-force participation rate minus female labour-force participation rate, in percentage points, from ILOSTAT. Higher = a wider gender gap in economic participation.

proxies.name: Total Exports of Fuel, Metals & Food (USD)
proxies.description: Total value of merchandise exports made up of strategic resources, fuel, metals & minerals, and food, in USD (billions), from World Bank WDI: merchandise exports (TX.VAL.MRCH.CD.WT) multiplied by the fuel/metals/food export shares (TX.VAL.FUEL/MMTL/FOOD.ZS.UN). Measures the absolute scale of a country's resource-export base, and thus its leverage over global energy, mineral and food markets. Higher = better positioned to weaponise resource access via energy cutoffs, mineral embargoes, or food-export restrictions.

proxies.name: Informal Employment Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of total employment that is informal, from ILOSTAT. Higher = greater exclusion from labour-market institutions and protections.

proxies.name: Social Assistance Coverage of Poorest Quintile (%)
proxies.description: Share of the poorest income quintile covered by a social-assistance program, from the World Bank ASPIRE database. Higher = broader protective reach for the poorest households.

proxies.name: Safely Managed Sanitation Coverage (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population using safely managed sanitation services, from the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme. Higher = better basic living standards.

proxies.name: Old-Age Pension / Income Coverage (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population above statutory pensionable age receiving an old-age pension, from ILO's World Social Protection Data (SDG 1.3.1). Higher = greater old-age income security.

proxies.name: Voice and Accountability Score (-2.5 to 2.5)
proxies.description: Composite measure of citizens' ability to participate in selecting their government and enjoy freedom of expression, association and media, from the World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators. Higher = greater democratic voice and accountability.

proxies.name: Civil Society Participation Index (0–1)
proxies.description: V-Dem index of the involvement of civil-society organisations in public life. Higher = more organised, autonomous civic participation.

proxies.name: Freedom of Peaceful Assembly (V-Dem scale)
proxies.description: V-Dem index of the extent to which the freedom of peaceful assembly is respected in practice. Higher = greater civic space to assemble freely.

proxies.name: Demonstration Events (per million population)
proxies.description: Number of recorded peaceful-demonstration events per million population, from ACLED's conflict-event database. Higher = greater civic mobilisation activity.

proxies.name: Political-Violence Fatalities (per million population)
proxies.description: Fatalities from politically motivated violence per million population, from ACLED. Higher = greater realised instability and violence.

proxies.name: Intentional Homicide Rate (per 100,000)
proxies.description: Number of intentional homicides per 100,000 population, from UNODC. Higher = greater everyday lethal violence.

proxies.name: % of UN Votes Aligned with Global Majority
proxies.description: Annual mean pairwise voting agreement between each country and all other UN member states, derived from the Voeten UN GA Agreement Scores dataset. Expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100. Higher values indicate a country consistently votes with the international consensus; lower values signal a revisionist or isolated posture. Taiwan excluded as a non-UN member.

proxies.name: Political Polarisation (V-Dem scale)
proxies.description: V-Dem Digital Society Survey index of societal polarization (v2smpolsoc), reverse-coded on an ordinal 0-4 scale (0 = serious polarization/major clashes of views, 4 = no polarization/general agreement). Higher = LESS political fragmentation and hostility, i.e. more consensus.

proxies.name: GDP (USD trillions, nominal)
proxies.description: Gross domestic product at current prices, in USD, from World Bank WDI, used in place of IMF WEO's real (constant-price) GDP, which was not available as originally specified. Higher = greater absolute economic size and scale.

proxies.name: PPP GDP Share of World (%)
proxies.description: A country's GDP at purchasing-power parity as a percentage of world PPP GDP, from the IMF World Economic Outlook. Higher = greater share of global economic weight.

proxies.name: GDP per Capita (USD, nominal)
proxies.description: Gross domestic product per capita at current prices, in USD, from World Bank WDI. Higher = greater average material living standard.

proxies.name: Labour Productivity per Employed Person (2021 PPP USD)
proxies.description: Output per employed person, in constant 2021 PPP USD, from ILOSTAT. Higher = more efficient use of labour.

proxies.name: Total Factor Productivity Index (2017=1)
proxies.description: Index of output not explained by capital and labour inputs alone, from the Penn World Table. Higher = greater technological/efficiency progress relative to 2017.

proxies.name: Gross Capital Formation (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Total investment in fixed assets and inventories as a percentage of GDP, from World Bank WDI. Higher = greater investment effort in the economy.

proxies.name: Manufacturing Value Added (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Manufacturing sector value added as a percentage of GDP, from UNIDO / World Bank WDI. Higher = a more manufacturing-intensive economic structure.

proxies.name: Services Value Added (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Services sector value added as a percentage of GDP, from World Bank WDI. Higher = a more services-oriented economic structure.

proxies.name: Outward FDI (USD millions)
proxies.description: Outward foreign direct investment in current USD (millions) from World Bank WDI. Higher = more capital deployed abroad, financial power projection. Non-positive flows are dropped, so the series is gross positive outward investment.

proxies.name: Trade Openness (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Exports plus imports of goods and services as a percentage of GDP, from World Bank WDI. Higher = deeper integration into the global economy.

proxies.name: Merchandise Exports Share of World (%)
proxies.description: A country's merchandise exports as a percentage of total world merchandise exports, from WTO Statistics. Higher = greater weight in global goods trade.

proxies.name: Commercial Services Exports Share of World (%)
proxies.description: A country's commercial-services exports as a percentage of total world commercial-services exports, from WTO Statistics. Higher = greater weight in global services trade.

proxies.name: Intra-Regional Trade Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of a country's total two-way trade conducted with partners in its own region, derived from UN Comtrade. Higher = greater regional trade integration relative to global trade.

proxies.name: Export Product Concentration Index (0–1)
proxies.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman index of how concentrated a country's exports are across product categories, from UNCTADstat. Higher = exports concentrated in fewer products (less diversified).

proxies.name: Trade-Weighted Applied Tariff (%)
proxies.description: Average tariff rate applied to imports, weighted by trade volumes, from WITS/WTO. Higher = greater trade-policy barriers to imports.

proxies.name: FDI Net Inflows (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Net foreign direct investment inflows as a percentage of GDP, from UNCTAD / World Bank WDI. Higher = greater cross-border capital integration.

proxies.name: Intermediate Goods Share of Trade (%)
proxies.description: Share of total two-way trade accounted for by intermediate (input) goods, derived from UN Comtrade. Higher = deeper participation in cross-border supply chains.

proxies.name: Trade Concentration by Geopolitical Bloc (HHI, 0-10000)
proxies.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman concentration index of each country's two-way merchandise trade (imports+exports) across three groups: the West bloc (USA, Canada, UK, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, Japan, Korea, Australia), the China+Russia bloc, and the rest of the world. Computed from UN Comtrade bilateral reporter-partner-year records (partner-level, cmdCode=TOTAL, flows M+X summed), 2000-2024, then forecast through 2040 by the standard damped-trend model. Higher = a country's trade is more concentrated in one bloc (less diversified / more 'locked in'); lower = trade is spread evenly across blocs (hedging). Built 2026-08-17 to fill the D158 gap flagged in the Topic 5 architecture and Topic 5 Appendix B.

proxies.name: Share of World Manufacturing Value Added (%)
proxies.description: A country's manufacturing value added as a percentage of world manufacturing value added, from UNIDO Statistics. Higher = greater share of global industrial production.

proxies.name: R&D Spending (USD millions)
proxies.description: Gross domestic R&D expenditure in current USD (millions) from World Bank WDI (GDP x R&D share of GDP). Higher = larger absolute investment in research and technological capability.

proxies.name: Economic Complexity Index (standardised)
proxies.description: Harvard Growth Lab's measure of the diversity and sophistication of a country's export basket. Higher = greater embedded productive know-how.

proxies.name: Domestic Value Added in Gross Exports (%)
proxies.description: Share of a country's gross exports attributable to domestically generated value, from OECD Trade in Value Added (TiVA). Higher = more of the export value chain captured domestically.

proxies.name: Foreign Value Added Share of Exports (%)
proxies.description: Share of a country's gross exports attributable to imported inputs, from OECD Trade in Value Added (TiVA). Higher = greater dependence on foreign inputs in export production.

proxies.name: Strategic-Goods Import Concentration (HHI, 0–1)
proxies.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman index of how concentrated a country's strategic-goods imports are among supplier countries, derived from UN Comtrade. Higher = greater supplier dependency/lock-in.

proxies.name: Net Energy Imports (% of Energy Use)
proxies.description: Net energy imports as a percentage of domestic energy use, from World Bank WDI. Higher = greater dependence on imported energy.

proxies.name: Food Import Dependency Ratio (%)
proxies.description: Cereal imports as a share of total cereal supply, from FAOSTAT. Higher = greater dependence on imported food.

proxies.name: Mineral Rents (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Rents from mineral extraction as a percentage of GDP, from World Bank WDI. Higher = greater economic exposure to mineral-resource leverage.

proxies.name: Liner Shipping Connectivity Index (Q1 2004=100)
proxies.description: UNCTAD's index of how well a country is connected to global liner shipping networks. Higher = better maritime trade connectivity.

proxies.name: Consumer Price Inflation (annual %)
proxies.description: Annual percentage change in consumer prices, from the IMF World Economic Outlook. Higher = faster price growth and greater inflationary pressure.

proxies.name: Government Gross Debt (% of GDP)
proxies.description: General government gross debt as a percentage of GDP, from the IMF World Economic Outlook. Higher = greater fiscal leverage/debt burden.

proxies.name: Interest Payments (% of Government Revenue)
proxies.description: Government interest payments as a percentage of government revenue, from IMF Government Finance Statistics / World Bank WDI. Higher = greater debt-service pressure on the budget.

proxies.name: Reserves in Months of Imports
proxies.description: Foreign-exchange reserves expressed in months of import cover, from IMF / World Bank WDI. Higher = greater external liquidity buffer.

proxies.name: Current-Account Balance (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Current-account balance as a percentage of GDP, from the IMF World Economic Outlook. Positive = external surplus; negative = external deficit.

proxies.name: External Debt Service (% of Exports)
proxies.description: External debt service payments as a percentage of exports of goods and services, from the World Bank International Debt Statistics. Higher = greater external repayment burden.

proxies.name: Domestic Credit to Private Sector (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Domestic credit extended to the private sector as a percentage of GDP, from IMF / World Bank WDI. Higher = deeper financial-sector leverage/intermediation.

proxies.name: Bank Non-Performing Loan Ratio (%)
proxies.description: Non-performing loans as a percentage of total gross loans, from the IMF Financial Soundness Indicators. Higher = greater banking-sector stress.

proxies.name: Employment-to-Population Ratio (%, age 15+)
proxies.description: Share of the working-age population that is employed, from ILOSTAT. Higher = greater labour-market absorption.

proxies.name: Unemployment Rate (%)
proxies.description: Share of the labour force that is unemployed, from ILOSTAT. Higher = greater unused labour capacity.

proxies.name: Wage and Salaried Workers Share (%)
proxies.description: Wage and salaried workers as a percentage of total employment, from ILOSTAT. Higher = a more formal, employer-based employment structure.

proxies.name: Frontier AI Training Compute (FLOP)
proxies.description: Annual cumulative maximum training compute, in floating-point operations, among models that Epoch AI flags as frontier models. Higher values indicate greater compute used at the AI frontier.

proxies.name: Household Consumption per Capita (USD)
proxies.description: Private household final consumption expenditure per person, in current USD, from World Bank WDI. Higher = greater average household material outcome.

proxies.name: Tax Revenue (% of GDP)
proxies.description: General government tax revenue as a percentage of GDP, from the UNU-WIDER Government Revenue Dataset / World Bank WDI. Higher = greater domestic fiscal capacity.

proxies.name: Social Expenditure (% of GDP)
proxies.description: General government social-protection expenditure as a percentage of GDP, from IMF Government Finance Statistics / OECD. Higher = greater collective shock-absorption capacity.

proxies.name: Top-1% Income Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of pre-tax national income received by the top 1% of earners, from the World Inequality Database. Higher = greater income concentration at the top.

proxies.name: TOP500 #1 Performance (TFlop/s)
proxies.description: Maximum Rmax performance of the rank-one TOP500 system in each year, taking the higher of the official June and November lists and normalizing all releases to TFlop/s. Higher values indicate a stronger global compute frontier.

proxies.name: Total Trade (USD billions)
proxies.description: Total merchandise trade (exports + imports) in current USD (billions) from World Bank WDI. Higher = a larger absolute trading economy and greater weight in global commerce.

proxies.name: Human Genome Sequencing Cost (USD)
proxies.description: NHGRI estimated cost to sequence a human-sized genome in current USD, using the last published observation in each calendar year. Lower values indicate more affordable genomic technology.

proxies.name: High-Technology Exports (USD)
proxies.description: Annual value of high-technology exports in current USD. Higher values indicate greater scale in producing and exporting technology-intensive goods.

proxies.name: ICT Goods Trade Balance (net USD)
proxies.description: ICT-goods exports minus ICT-goods imports in current USD, derived from merchandise trade values and ICT-goods shares. Positive values indicate net export strength; negative values indicate import dependence.

proxies.name: Medium/High-Tech Manufacturing Value Added (USD)
proxies.description: Estimated annual medium- and high-technology manufacturing value added in current USD, calculated as total manufacturing value added multiplied by the medium/high-tech share. Higher values indicate greater advanced-production capability.

proxies.name: Researchers in R&D (per million people)
proxies.unit: No. of researchers per million people
proxies.description: Number of research-and-development researchers per million people. Higher values indicate a deeper national research talent base.

proxies.name: Scientific & Technical Journal Articles (count)
proxies.description: Annual number of scientific and engineering articles published in covered journals. Higher values indicate greater formal knowledge output.

proxies.name: ICT Service Exports (USD)
proxies.description: Annual exports of telecommunications, computer and information services in current USD. Higher values indicate greater internationally traded digital-services capability.

proxies.name: Individuals Using the Internet (%)
proxies.description: Percentage of the population that used the Internet during the reference period. Higher values indicate broader baseline digital access; the measure naturally saturates near 100%.

proxies.name: Secure Internet Servers (per million people)
proxies.unit: No. of servers per million people
proxies.description: Number of secure Internet servers per million people. Higher values indicate denser trusted digital and commercial infrastructure.

proxies.name: Soft Power Index Score (0–100)
proxies.description: Annual composite score from the Brand Finance Global Soft Power Index rated 0–100, covering Business & Trade, Governance, International Relations, Culture & Heritage, Media & Communication, and Education & Science. A higher score means greater ability to attract partnerships and shape norms without coercion.

proxies.name: Data-Center Market Revenue (USD millions)
proxies.description: Modeled annual data-center market revenue in USD millions. Higher values indicate greater domestic scale in compute infrastructure and hosting capacity.

proxies.name: Semiconductor Market Revenue (USD millions)
proxies.description: Modeled annual semiconductor market revenue in USD millions. Higher values indicate greater domestic chip-industry scale and participation.

proxies.name: Industrial Robot Import Intensity (2015 USD per 10,000 manufacturing workers)
proxies.description: Annual CIF value of industrial-robot imports under HS 847950, plus HS 842870 from 2022, deflated to 2015 USD using the US CPI and divided by ILOSTAT modelled manufacturing employment, then multiplied by 10,000. Higher values indicate more intensive cross-border acquisition of industrial automation. This is an import-investment proxy, not installed robot stock; robots produced and used domestically are excluded.

proxies.name: ICT-Specialist Employment Share (%)
proxies.description: Percentage of total employment working in ICT-specialist occupations. Higher values indicate a larger digital and technical workforce.

proxies.name: ICT Graduates Share (%)
proxies.description: Percentage of tertiary graduates completing information and communication technology fields. Higher values indicate a stronger future digital-skills pipeline.

proxies.name: Labour Productivity Growth: Output/Hour (%)
proxies.description: Annual percentage growth in real output per hour worked. Positive values indicate improving labour productivity; negative values indicate contraction.

proxies.name: Labour Income Share (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Labour compensation as a percentage of gross domestic product. Higher values indicate a larger share of national income accruing to labour rather than capital.

proxies.name: GDP (USD trillions)
proxies.description: Gross domestic product in current USD (trillions) from World Bank WDI. Higher = greater absolute economic size and weight.

proxies.name: Domestic Value Added in ICT Exports (%)
proxies.description: Domestic value added embodied in ICT/electronics exports as a percentage of gross exports. Higher values indicate that more value-chain income is retained domestically.

proxies.name: Net Intellectual-Property Income (USD)
proxies.description: Charges for the use of intellectual property received from abroad minus payments to foreign owners, in current USD. Positive values indicate net ownership rents; negative values indicate net IP dependence.

proxies.name: Digitally Delivered Services Trade Balance (USD millions)
proxies.description: Exports minus imports of digitally delivered services in USD millions. Positive values indicate a net digital-services surplus; negative values indicate a deficit.

proxies.name: Internet-Use Gender Gap (percentage points)
proxies.description: Male Internet-use rate minus female Internet-use rate, in percentage points. Positive values indicate higher use among men; negative values indicate higher use among women.

proxies.name: Urban–Rural Internet-Use Gap (percentage points)
proxies.description: Urban Internet-use rate minus rural Internet-use rate, in percentage points. Positive values indicate an urban advantage; negative values indicate higher rural use.

proxies.name: Mobile-Broadband Affordability (% GNI per capita)
proxies.description: Price of the selected mobile-broadband basket as a percentage of monthly gross national income per capita. Lower values indicate more affordable access.

proxies.name: Government Social-Media Monitoring (0–4)
proxies.description: V-Dem Digital Society Project original-scale score for government monitoring of social media. Higher values indicate less comprehensive government monitoring.

proxies.name: National Power Capacity Score (0–1)
proxies.description: The Correlates of War CINC score ranging 0–1, summing six world-share components: military expenditure, military personnel, iron & steel production, energy consumption, urban population, and total population. A higher score means a larger share of total global material power capacity across military, industrial, and demographic dimensions.

proxies.name: Government Internet Filtering in Practice (0–4)
proxies.description: V-Dem Digital Society Project original-scale score for government filtering of online content in practice. Higher values indicate less government filtering.

proxies.name: Government False Information (0–4)
proxies.description: V-Dem Digital Society Project original-scale score for government dissemination of false information domestically. Higher values indicate less frequent government disinformation.

proxies.name: Offline Action Organized via Social Media (0–4)
proxies.description: V-Dem Digital Society Project original-scale score for citizens using social media to organize offline political action. Higher values indicate greater citizen organizing capacity.

proxies.name: Arrest for Online Political Content (0–3)
proxies.description: V-Dem Digital Society Project original-scale score for the likelihood of arrest due to political content posted online. Higher values indicate that arrest is less likely.

proxies.name: Online Privacy Protection in Law (0–4)
proxies.description: V-Dem Digital Society Project original-scale score for the strength of legal protection for online privacy. Higher values indicate stronger protection in law.

proxies.name: Freedom on the Net Score (0–100)
proxies.description: Freedom House composite assessment of obstacles to access, limits on content and violations of user rights. Higher values indicate greater Internet freedom.

proxies.name: UN E-Participation Index (0–1)
proxies.description: UN DESA index of governments' online information provision, consultation and participation in decision-making. Higher values indicate stronger digital civic participation.

proxies.name: Daily Time Spent on Social Media (minutes)
proxies.description: Average daily minutes spent using social media among the covered Internet-user population. Higher values indicate greater attention devoted to or dependence on social platforms.

proxies.name: Global Mean Surface Temperature Anomaly (°C)
proxies.description: Annual global land-ocean surface temperature departure from the 1901–2000 average, in degrees Celsius, from NOAA NCEI's Global Land and Ocean Temperature dataset (official fallback for the WMO/Copernicus State of the Climate series). Higher = greater global warming above the historical baseline.

proxies.name: Atmospheric CO₂ Concentration (ppm)
proxies.description: Global annual mean atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration in parts per million, from NOAA's Global Monitoring Laboratory. Higher = greater accumulation of the primary greenhouse gas driving warming.

proxies.name: Western Alignment Score (UN ideal-point index)
proxies.description: Bayesian ideal point estimate from UN General Assembly voting records (Voeten dataset). Positive values indicate alignment with the Western liberal order; negative values indicate alignment with Russia, China, and Iran's revisionist bloc. The further positive, the more the country votes with Western democracies; the further negative, the more it defies the rules-based order.

proxies.name: Global Mean Sea-Level Change (mm)
proxies.description: Global mean sea-level change in millimetres relative to 2005, combining NASA satellite-altimetry observations with IPCC AR6 median-scenario projections for future years. Higher = more sea-level rise and greater committed coastal exposure.

proxies.name: Global Ocean Heat Content (10²² J)
proxies.description: Annual anomaly in the heat stored in the upper 700 metres of the world's oceans, in 10²² joules, from NOAA NCEI. Higher = more heat energy accumulating in the ocean system.

proxies.name: Ocean Acidification: Surface pH
proxies.description: Global annual mean surface-seawater pH (total scale) from Copernicus Marine Service satellite/in-situ observations. Lower = more acidic oceans and greater stress on marine ecosystems.

proxies.name: Total Greenhouse-Gas Emissions, excl. LULUCF (Mt CO2e)
proxies.description: Annual national greenhouse-gas emissions excluding land-use change and forestry, in megatonnes of CO2-equivalent, from the EDGAR emissions inventory (via World Bank Data360). Higher = a larger absolute contribution to global emissions.

proxies.name: Fossil CO₂ Emissions per Capita (t CO2e)
proxies.unit: Tonnes of CO2 equivalent per capita
proxies.description: Annual fossil-fuel CO2 emissions per person, in tonnes of CO2-equivalent, sourced from World Bank Data360 as an alternative to the named Global Carbon Project download. Higher = greater average per-person carbon footprint.

proxies.name: Methane Emissions per Capita (t CO2e)
proxies.unit: Tonnes of CO2 equivalent per capita
proxies.description: Annual methane emissions per person, converted to tonnes of CO2-equivalent, from the EDGAR emissions inventory via World Bank Data360. Higher = greater average per-person non-CO2 warming contribution.

proxies.name: Country Annual Temperature Anomaly (°C)
proxies.description: Country-level annual mean surface-temperature departure from the 1991–2020 average, in degrees Celsius, from Our World in Data's Copernicus ERA5-based country series (alternative to the named World Bank CCKP route). Higher = greater local warming above baseline.

proxies.name: Population-Weighted Days Above 35°C (days/year)
proxies.description: Annual count of days with maximum temperature at or above 35°C, from the World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal's ERA5-Land reanalysis. Higher = more extreme-heat days and greater livability/health stress.

proxies.name: Maximum Five-Day Precipitation (mm)
proxies.description: Average largest 5-day cumulative precipitation total in a year, in millimetres, from the World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal's ERA5-Land reanalysis. Higher = more extreme rainfall and greater flood risk.

proxies.name: Consecutive Dry Days (days)
proxies.description: Maximum number of consecutive dry days in a year, from the World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal's ERA5-Land reanalysis. Higher = longer drought spells and greater water-stress risk.

proxies.name: Arms Supplier Concentration (HHI x100)
proxies.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman index of a country's arms-import suppliers over a 5-year rolling window (SIPRI TIV), rescaled to 0-100. Higher = imports concentrated in one/few suppliers (locked-in / clearly aligned); lower = diversified across many (hedging / strategic autonomy).

proxies.name: Western Arms Supplier Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of a country's arms imports (5-year rolling SIPRI TIV) sourced from Western/allied suppliers (NATO + EU + Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, Israel).

proxies.name: Eastern Arms Supplier Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of arms imports sourced from the Russia/China revisionist bloc (Russia, China, North Korea, Iran, Belarus).

proxies.name: Other Arms Supplier Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of arms imports from non-aligned suppliers (neither Western nor Eastern bloc). Residual = 100 - Western - Eastern.

proxies.name: Population-Weighted PM2.5 Exposure (µg/m³)
proxies.description: Mean annual concentration of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) that the population is exposed to, in micrograms per cubic metre, from World Bank WDI. Higher = worse air quality and greater public-health burden.

proxies.name: Disaster Mortality (deaths per 100,000 people)
proxies.description: Deaths and missing persons attributed to disasters per 100,000 population, on a 5-year rolling basis, from the UNDRR Sendai Framework Monitor. Higher = greater realised human loss from disasters.

proxies.name: Disaster Displacement (per 100,000 people)
proxies.description: New internal displacements caused by disasters per 100,000 population, from the Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre's Global Internal Displacement Database. Higher = greater forced-mobility pressure from disasters.

proxies.name: Level of Water Stress: SDG 6.4.2 (%)
proxies.description: Freshwater withdrawal as a percentage of available renewable freshwater resources, from FAO AQUASTAT (via World Bank Data360). Higher = greater water scarcity pressure.

proxies.name: Renewable Freshwater Resources per Capita (m³)
proxies.description: Total renewable freshwater resources per person, in cubic metres, from FAO AQUASTAT (via World Bank Data360). Higher = greater water endowment relative to population.

proxies.name: Water-Use Efficiency: SDG 6.4.1 (USD/m³)
proxies.description: Economic value added per cubic metre of water used, in constant USD, from FAO AQUASTAT (via World Bank Data360). Higher = more economic output generated per unit of water.

proxies.name: Cereal Yield (kg/ha)
proxies.description: Average cereal crop yield, in kilograms per hectare, from FAOSTAT (via World Bank Data360). Higher = greater food-system productivity.

proxies.name: Food Production Index per Capita (2014–2016=100)
proxies.description: Index of per-capita food production relative to the 2014–2016 base period, from FAOSTAT (via World Bank). Higher = greater domestic food availability per person.

proxies.name: Food Insecurity Prevalence, Moderate or Severe (%)
proxies.description: Share of the population experiencing moderate or severe food insecurity, from FAOSTAT's Food Insecurity Experience Scale survey (SDG 2.1.2). Higher = greater household food stress.

proxies.name: Food Price Anomalies: SDG 2.c.1 (Index)
proxies.description: Index of domestic food-price volatility relative to historical norms, from the FAO SDG data portal. Higher = greater abnormal food-price volatility and transmission risk.

proxies.name: UN Vote Agreement with USA (%)
proxies.description: Pairwise UN General Assembly voting coincidence rate between the country and the USA (share of votes cast the same way).

proxies.name: UN Vote Agreement with China (%)
proxies.description: Pairwise UN General Assembly voting coincidence rate between the country and China (share of votes cast the same way).

proxies.name: UN Vote Agreement with Russia (%)
proxies.description: Pairwise UN General Assembly voting coincidence rate between the country and Russia (share of votes cast the same way).

proxies.name: UN Vote Agreement with India (%)
proxies.description: Pairwise UN General Assembly voting coincidence rate between the country and India (share of votes cast the same way).

proxies.name: Red List Index: SDG 15.5.1 (0–1)
proxies.description: IUCN Red List Index of species survival, from the UN SDG database. Higher = less extinction risk and greater biodiversity integrity.

proxies.name: Renewable-Energy Share of Final Consumption (%)
proxies.description: Renewable energy as a percentage of total final energy consumption, from the UN SDG 7.2.1 indicator (via World Bank Data360). Higher = greater economy-wide progress on the energy transition.

proxies.name: Renewable Electricity Capacity per Capita (W)
proxies.description: Installed renewable electricity generation capacity per person, in watts, from IRENA's electricity capacity statistics. Higher = greater clean-power build-out relative to population.

proxies.name: Fossil-Fuel Share of Electricity Generation (%)
proxies.description: Share of electricity generated from fossil fuels, from Ember's global electricity data. Higher = greater power-system lock-in to fossil generation.

proxies.name: Primary Energy Intensity of GDP: SDG 7.3.1 (MJ/USD)
proxies.description: Primary energy use per unit of GDP, in megajoules per constant 2021 PPP USD, from the UN SDG / IEA indicator (via World Bank Data360). Lower = more energy-efficient economic output.

proxies.name: Power-Sector Carbon Intensity (gCO2/kWh)
proxies.description: Grams of CO2 emitted per kilowatt-hour of electricity generated, from Ember's global electricity data. Lower = cleaner electricity generation.

proxies.name: Electric-Vehicle Sales Share (%)
proxies.description: Share of new car sales that are electric vehicles, from the IEA Global EV Outlook. Higher = faster transport electrification.

proxies.name: Emissions Covered by Direct Carbon Pricing (%)
proxies.description: Share of a country's greenhouse-gas emissions covered by an active carbon tax or emissions-trading scheme, from the World Bank Carbon Pricing Dashboard. Higher = broader policy commitment to pricing carbon.

proxies.name: Trade Share with USA (%)
proxies.description: Share of the country's total goods trade (imports + exports) directed to the USA, from UN Comtrade.

proxies.name: Trade Share with China (%)
proxies.description: Share of the country's total goods trade (imports + exports) directed to China, from UN Comtrade.

proxies.name: Trade Share with Russia (%)
proxies.description: Share of the country's total goods trade (imports + exports) directed to Russia, from UN Comtrade.

proxies.name: Trade Share with India (%)
proxies.description: Share of the country's total goods trade (imports + exports) directed to India, from UN Comtrade.

proxies.name: Trade Share with Others (%)
proxies.description: Share of total goods trade with the rest of the world (all partners except USA, China, Russia, India). Residual = 100 - the four anchors.

proxies.name: Material Footprint per Capita: SDG 12.2.1 (tonnes)
proxies.description: Raw material extraction attributable to domestic final demand, per person, in tonnes, from UNEP's International Resource Panel Global Material Flows Database. Higher = greater per-person material consumption pressure.

proxies.name: Critical-Mineral Net Import Dependence (%)
proxies.description: Net imports of critical minerals as a share of domestic consumption, derived from UN Comtrade trade flows. Higher = greater dependence on foreign supply for the energy transition.

proxies.name: ND-GAIN Vulnerability Score (0–1)
proxies.description: Composite score of exposure, sensitivity and adaptive capacity to climate hazards, from the Notre Dame Global Adaptation Initiative (ND-GAIN) Country Index. Higher = greater climate vulnerability.

proxies.name: ND-GAIN Readiness Score (0–1)
proxies.description: Composite score of a country's ability to leverage investment for climate adaptation, from the ND-GAIN Country Index. Higher = greater readiness to convert resources into adaptive action.

proxies.name: INFORM Lack of Coping Capacity (0–10)
proxies.description: Composite indicator of institutional and infrastructural fragility in responding to disasters, from the EU JRC's INFORM Risk Index. Higher = weaker coping capacity.

proxies.name: Direct Disaster Economic Loss (% of GDP)
proxies.description: Direct economic losses from disasters as a share of GDP, on a rolling basis, from the UNDRR Sendai Framework Monitor. Higher = greater realised fiscal/economic burden from disasters.

proxies.name: National/Local DRR Strategy Coverage (0–1)
proxies.description: Extent to which national and local disaster-risk-reduction strategies are in place, from the UNDRR Sendai Framework Monitor. Higher = stronger risk-governance commitment.

proxies.name: Climate-Related Development Finance Received per Capita (USD)
proxies.description: Climate-adaptation-marked development finance received, per person, in USD, from the OECD DAC Creditor Reporting System (Rio markers). Higher = greater external finance flowing toward adaptation.
